 CLIP-IN EXTENSIONS – Clip & Go is an affordable 100% Human Remy 6 piece clip in extension sold worldwide. Our best seller every year! This process ensures that the hair remains super soft, shiny, silky and completely tangle-free throughout its lifetime.

These come in straight and can be curled, straightened, trimmed, dyed, washed, and blow-dried. Choose from a range of natural hair colors to match every mood.

The great quality of this hair extension rivals that of more expensive, high-end hair extensions, but for only a fraction of the cost.
